claims.text: Total revenues for COMPANY_06 increased by 5.10% in fiscal year 2025, reaching $680,985 million, compared to $648,125 million in fiscal year 2024.
Net sales also saw a 5.00% increase in fiscal year 2025, rising to $674,538 million from $642,637 million in fiscal year 2024.
Operating income for COMPANY_06 grew by 8.65% in fiscal year 2025, reaching $29,348 million, up from $27,012 million in fiscal year 2024.
Despite strong competition from various retailers and evolving omni-channel landscapes (Item 1A), COMPANY_06 has demonstrated growth in key financial metrics.

rationale: COMPANY_06 shows strong financial performance with consistent growth in total revenues, net sales, and operating income. While the company operates in a highly competitive retail environment, its ability to achieve these positive results suggests resilience and effective strategies. The growth in membership and other income also points to a stable customer base and diversified revenue streams. These factors collectively support a BUY recommendation.
